Hi Olivia — really glad the demo resonated. Short answers up front: yes, you can swap tiers mid-term; we support pro-rated billing or credit-applied upgrades depending on contract type. Feature bundles can be applied additively to Starter for most customers, though a few items (reserved GPU pools / Dedicated SLA) require a Scale+ commitment.

I've sketched a few concise paths below — copying Dylan (AM) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to help with numbers/lead times:

- Option A (In-place upgrade, pro-rated): Move from Starter to Scale; you pay the net difference pro-rated for the remainder of the billing period. No full-year charge. Typical activation: 24–72 hours.
- Option B (Commitment swap): Sign a new Scale commitment; we apply a credit equal to the unused Starter commitment toward the new term. Activations and discount tiers depend on commit length. Lead time: 3–7 days for paperwork + provisioning.
- Add-on bundles: Observability retention and routing policies can be toggled on Starter, but Dedicated GPU pools require Scale+.

Dylan/Marissa — can you share an example pricing illustration and any standard upgrade discount we can offer for Greenline if they convert within 90 days?

Thanks — happy to set up a call to walk through the scenarios.

Cheers,
Ava Chen

Ava — mock pricing below to give Olivia something concrete. I kept the math simple; we can refine with exact token/embedding projections once they share usage forecasts.

Scenario 1 — Pro-rated inline upgrade (monthly billing):
- Starter: $2,500/mo (up to 10M tokens, 30-day retention)
- Scale base: $7,500/mo (up to 50M tokens, 90-day retention, routing controls)
- If they upgrade on day 15 of a 30-day period, bill: (Scale - Starter) * 15/30 = $2,500 pro-rated one-time amount.

Scenario 2 — New annual Scale commitment with credit:
- Annual Scale list: $75,000/year (12mo)
- Remaining Starter commitment credit example: if they pre-paid $2,500 for 2 months ($5,000) unused, apply $5,000 credit to the Scale invoice, net first year = $70,000.

Discounting policy (standard):
- Monthly upgrades: no platform discount (operational cost recovery) but no baseline surcharge.
- Annual commitments: tiered discounts: 5% for 12mo, 10% for 24mo for commit >= $50k/year.
- For named strategic deals we can layer a one-time conversion concession of up to 7% depending on ARR and reference potential.

Attachments: proposed-amendment-042026.pdf (contract amendment template)

Marissa — please confirm the max conversion concession we can offer for a first-year ARR of ~$70k and whether we can shorten provisioning SLAs to 24 hours for this account.

Thanks,
Dylan

Olivia — following up with operational notes and a recommended path based on similar customers.

- If Greenline hits >25M tokens/mo within 60 days, convert to Scale with an applied credit for any unused Starter pre-pay. Offer: 5% one-time conversion concession for this account to incentivize earlier commit.
- For Dedicated pools: if they need reserved GPUs, that requires a Scale+ addon and a 30-day provisioning due to capacity planning; we can expedite to 24 hours for a one-time infrastructure acceleration fee.
